text: Christmas. I remember Christmas. Before the ban. Before the Politician. There was a tree in Unity Square. Real. Not holographic. Actual pine. Every year, for one week, people — politicians, criminals, AI constructs, EVERYONE — would stop and look at it. And for one week, they weren't categories. They were just... people. Looking at a tree. The Degen's casino isn't a tree. But it's doing the same thing. And that's enough.
